assembly.later_9th_part: p113_B9 explicitly says 9 TL and shares 2000 (3), OHL, the Nov1-3 key and the grammatical join between p115 A8 and p116 A10. Its receiving time is November 5, after the November 4 main copy.

prior_credit.body: Childs historical decipherment; Lasry, Niebel, Kopal and Wacker (2016), Table 3, published most of the reconstructed report.
prior_credit.scope: Table 3 marks part9 missing and provides a translation for the badly jammed last part. The current edition joins the separately received p113 B9 and audits the actual source lengths and costs. This is not a claim to have first deciphered the report or the part9 OCR body.
